titleFront: You Can Either Profit By This...

flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Han is on Tatooine and not a captive (spot Han with on(Tatooine) and not(captive); includes excluded-from-battle but NOT captives, so frozen/imprisoned Han never satisfies it).

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Han is captured or not on table (cannot spot a non-captive Han anywhere).

requirementSemantics: Flip both ways is CHARACTER-STATE spotting on the persona Han: front needs free (non-captive) Han located on planet Tatooine; back holds while a free Han exists ANYWHERE (back check drops the on-Tatooine requirement).
Neither side checks control or occupy for the flip.
HARD-LOSE both sides: if Tatooine system is 'blown away' (isBlownAwayLastStep), objective is placed out of play. Front Card110_004.java:126-137; back Card110_004_BACK.java:56-67
One-shot on flip to back (cardFlipped trigger, once per game GameTextActionId.OR_BE_DESTROYED__RETRIEVE_FORCE): retrieve 5 Force, or 10 if Han's power < 4. Card110_004_BACK.java:69-95
